world.title: Video: Australian Senator Holds Baby While Speaking In Parliament, Colleague Plays Peek-A-Boo
world.summary: Australian Senator Fatima Payman delivered a speech in Parliament while holding her six-month-old daughter, Aaliyah. The moment gained attention online as fellow Senator Lidia Thorpe entertained the baby with playful faces and a game of peek-a-boo from her seat. This heartwarming scene showcased a blend of parliamentary duties and family life, resonating with viewers across social media.

world.title: 'Russia wants more than Ukraine," says Germany's Merz as he defends aid for Kyiv
world.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz stated that Russia's actions pose escalating threats to European security. He defended the German government's plans to increase defense spending and continue financial support for Ukraine. Merz emphasized the importance of aiding Kyiv in the face of Russian aggression, asserting that the situation extends beyond Ukraine, highlighting broader implications for European stability and security.

world.title: Who is Chen Jining, China’s latest Politburo member under investigation?
world.summary: Chen Jining, Shanghai's party secretary, is under investigation by the Chinese Communist Party for alleged "serious violations of discipline and law," typically indicating corruption. He is the fourth high-ranking Politburo member to face scrutiny in two years. The Central Commission for Discipline Inspection is overseeing the investigation, reflecting ongoing efforts to combat corruption within the party.

business.title: BP transfers 3,000 finance operations staff to Indian AI services firm Wipro
business.summary: BP has signed a deal with Indian tech firm Wipro to transfer 3,000 finance operations staff from India, Hungary, and Malaysia. This move is part of BP's strategy to expand outsourcing, reflecting a trend among global companies to shift in-house support functions to specialized IT services providers. The aim is to streamline operations, reduce costs, and enhance productivity.

business.title: Why India is betting Rs 11,000 crore on construction, infrastructure equipment manufacturing - explained
business.summary: The Union Cabinet of India has approved a scheme worth Rs 11,000 crore aimed at enhancing the construction and infrastructure equipment (CIE) manufacturing sector. The initiative focuses on boosting domestic production, supporting component manufacturers, and establishing a robust ecosystem for CIE. This move is part of India's broader strategy to strengthen its manufacturing capabilities in critical industries.

business.title: AM Markets Need to Know: Trump eyes Nvidia stake, China AI, and more
business.summary: Stock index futures declined on Wednesday, with Nasdaq futures experiencing the most significant drop due to renewed selling pressure on technology stocks. Concerns over escalating trade tensions were heightened by reports of new U.S. tariff plans. Investors are advised to monitor developments regarding Trump's interest in Nvidia, China's advancements in AI, and other key market factors.

technology.title: GTA 6 without a PS5 on PlayStation Portal: Early cloud impressions reveal the catch
technology.summary: Players can now access Grand Theft Auto VI on the PlayStation Portal through Sony's cloud streaming service without needing a PS5. Initial community feedback has been mostly positive, highlighting the affordability of the handheld device, priced around $300. However, there are limitations to this setup that players should be aware of, which may affect the overall experience.

technology.title: Durban's Super Giants set to appoint Williamson as head coach for SA20
technology.summary: Durban's Super Giants are set to appoint Kane Williamson as their head coach for SA20 2027, replacing Lance Klusener. Klusener has been with the team since the inaugural 2023 season. Williamson's appointment marks a significant change for the franchise as they aim to enhance their performance in the upcoming tournament. Details regarding Williamson's coaching strategy are yet to be revealed.

technology.title: Samsung Launches 1,100Hz Gaming Monitor, But There Is A Catch
technology.summary: Samsung has launched the Odyssey G6 gaming monitor, achieving refresh rates of 1,100Hz at HD resolution and 600Hz at QHD, aimed at competitive gamers. While the high refresh rates are impressive, there are limitations regarding its performance and compatibility. The monitor is designed to enhance gaming experiences, but potential buyers should consider these factors before purchasing.

sports.title: Mumbai Indians hint at Rohit Sharma captaincy return for IPL 2027
sports.summary: Mumbai Indians suggested Rohit Sharma may return as captain for IPL 2027, replacing Hardik Pandya. This indication came from a social media post on November 25, 2026, featuring an animated hand holding a Mumbai Indians cap. The franchise's leadership change has generated interest among fans and analysts, prompting discussions about the team's future direction and strategy.

sports.title: Dottin bowled off a 'free ball' under WBBL's modified Timed Out law
sports.summary: Deandra Dottin experienced an unusual incident in the WBBL when she was bowled off a "free ball" after arriving late to the crease. The modified Timed Out law allowed Sarah Glenn to bowl at the unguarded stumps, resulting in Dottin's dismissal. This incident highlights the unique regulations in the Women’s Big Bash League regarding player timing and penalties.

sports.title: Shakib, Mustafizur not among Bangladeshi players on 2027 IPL auction list
sports.summary: Former captain Shakib Al-Hasan and fast bowler Mustafizur Rahman are not included in the list of 11 Bangladeshi players registered for the 2027 Indian Premier League (IPL) auction. This follows Mustafiz's exclusion from the league last year. The absence of these prominent players highlights ongoing tensions within Bangladeshi cricket and the IPL's evolving dynamics.

health.title: High PSA Score Does Not Always Indicate Prostate Cancer, Experts Advise Against Panic
health.summary: Experts advise that a high PSA score does not always indicate prostate cancer. Previously, a score above four prompted biopsies, but the American Cancer Society now recommends assessing PSA levels alongside an individual's age, medical history, and other risk factors. This approach aims to reduce unnecessary panic and improve the accuracy of prostate cancer screenings.

health.title: 78-year-old musician with Alzheimer’s found 100 miles from home playing piano after mysterious disappearance
health.summary: Frank Grow, a 78-year-old musician with Alzheimer's, was found 100 miles from home playing piano after going missing. His disappearance prompted a missing-person search, which concluded with a touching reunion. The incident highlights the impact of music and community support in times of distress, showcasing how kindness can play a significant role in reconnecting loved ones.

health.title: The high cost of midnight lapses in hospitals
health.summary: Nighttime care in hospitals is essential for patient safety, involving consultants, nursing, and administrative staff. Lapses during these hours can compromise patient well-being and lead to legal liabilities for healthcare providers. The critical nature of nighttime healthcare highlights the need for adequate staffing and attention to ensure that patients receive continuous and effective care, even during late hours.

science.title: Researchers to develop first-ever MRI chair
science.summary: A research consortium led by Radboud University Medical Center and Tesla Engineering is developing the first-ever MRI chair, designed for patient comfort and ease of use. This innovative scanner aims to improve prostate cancer detection with advanced technology. The project has received €25 million in funding to support its development, promising a more accessible and silent MRI experience.

science.title: China-Pakistan space station experiment to test graphene-based hybrid composites for radiation shielding
science.summary: Pakistan's Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission (SUPARCO) has proposed an experiment to test graphene-based hybrid composites for radiation shielding in space. The experiment will be conducted outside China's Tiangong space station and is part of a joint initiative between China and Pakistan. This project aims to evaluate the materials' performance in the harsh conditions of space.

science.title: Royal Society of Chemistry brings together leading voices in chemistry at the seventh ChemSci 2026: Leaders in the Field Symposium at IISER Bhopal.
science.summary: The Royal Society of Chemistry hosted the seventh ChemSci 2026: Leaders in the Field Symposium at IISER Bhopal on November 25, 2026. This event marks the 16th anniversary of the RSC's gold open access journal, Chemical Science. The two-and-a-half-day symposium aims to enhance scientific knowledge exchange, promote interdisciplinary collaboration, and provide networking opportunities within the chemistry community in India.

entertainment.title: Bollywood union asks Modi to bar Netflix's Pakistani series in India
entertainment.summary: A Bollywood workers' union has requested Prime Minister Narendra Modi to prohibit the upcoming Pakistani series "Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo" on Netflix in India. The union is also advocating for legislation to ban content from Pakistan. The series, set to premiere on December 4, is Netflix's first Urdu-language production and features several prominent Pakistani actors.

entertainment.title: Arjun Kapoor, Sahiba Bali's Guruparab selfie sparks dating rumours again: 'I ate his half of the prashaad too'
entertainment.summary: Arjun Kapoor and Sahiba Bali's recent Instagram post has reignited dating speculation between the two. The photo was shared during the celebration of Guruparab, where Sahiba humorously mentioned eating half of Arjun's prashaad. This appearance follows ongoing rumors about their relationship, as the actor and sports presenter continue to attract public interest regarding their potential romantic involvement.

entertainment.title: O.M Operation Mole Box Office Collection Day 6
entertainment.summary: On Day 6, "O.M Operation Mole" collected a net of ₹2.61 crore, bringing its total to ₹61.45 crore after five days. The film is currently screened in 4,521 shows, with ₹1.62 crore from Tamil, ₹84 lakh from Telugu, and ₹15 lakh from Hindi. The latest collection figures were reported as of 6:03 PM IST.
